item.title: Black Spade bringing Squid Game: The Experience to Southeast Asia
item.description:
>
Black Spade bringing Squid Game: The Experience to Southeast Asia Black Spade, the family office of Melco International Chairman Lawrence Ho, is pleased to announce its role alongside Kingsmen Xperience in bringing Netflix’s Squid Game: The Experience to Indonesia with local operator SideQuest Worlds, part of PT Vista Adhya Paragon, bringing expertise in media and immersive entertainment. Opening yesterday (16 October) at Agora Mall in Jakarta’s Thamrin Nine complex, home to the nation’s tallest new landmark.   As the first Squid Game: The Experience in Southeast Asia, it brings the acclaimed series to life through immersive environments and interactive challenges. Spanning more than 1,900 square metres, the attraction features games inspired by the series, themed environments, photo zones and food and beverage offerings. Following editions in cities such as New York, Madrid, Seoul, London, Sydney and Tokyo, Jakarta welcomes this global entertainment experience, offering a brand-new interactive entertainment option for Indonesian audiences and visitors from across the region.
